findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current renders shows the overskirt side panels forming sharp triangular flaps in sit and crouch, with front/back fabric hanging between the legs. Standing front, back, left, right and three-quarter views retain repeated narrow side ridges and pointed outward hem corners. The V93 shorts shell has a more regular clipped leg opening, but its broad faceted surface remains prototype-quality.

The measured under-shorts upper-thigh coverage is 68.6% neutral, 64.2% crouch and 63.8% sit. These geometric coverage measurements do not establish a sewn garment, fit, collision clearance, or acceptable visual coverage.
The direct render set does not establish avatar fit, shape-key response, UV completion, Unity/VRChat runtime or customer release readiness. Keep all independent quality gates unchanged.

nextAction: Retain the clipped V93 shorts boundary. Reduce the overskirt panel hem extension and forward apron length, and reduce radial fold cuts to test whether shorter, broader panels eliminate the sharp posed flaps and repeated side ridges. Rebuild and inspect fresh sit/crouch and standing views; UV remains NOT_CREATED.
